title: IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理
titleEn: IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy
summary: 建立『IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付固定窗與等角度兩種實驗設計，並標出不能直接比較的欄位。
summaryEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver fixed-window and equal-angle experiment plans, marking incomparable fields.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。固定窗代理要求≤0.003由200 GHz組通過；完整選擇須比較門時長、功率限制與其他能階。 與本階段判準一起判讀：介面表應明示輸出單位expected scattering events、全部輸入與下列模型限制：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。

steps.title: 案例介面與可識別量 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Case interfaces and identifiable quantities · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「案例介面與可識別量」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付固定窗與等角度兩種實驗設計，並標出不能直接比較的欄位。
在交接件中加入「案例介面與可識別量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：介面表應明示輸出單位expected scattering events、全部輸入與下列模型限制：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立『IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付固定窗與等角度兩種實驗設計，並標出不能直接比較的欄位。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver fixed-window and equal-angle experiment plans, marking incomparable fields.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities: The interface table must state output unit expected scattering events, all inputs and these model limits: At fixed single-photon drive, scattering proxy Γsc∝1/Δ²; Raman coupling also changes with detuning, so scattering is not the only metric. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver fixed-window and equal-angle experiment plans, marking incomparable fields. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。介面表應明示輸出單位expected scattering events、全部輸入與下列模型限制：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. The interface table must state output unit expected scattering events, all inputs and these model limits: At fixed single-photon drive, scattering proxy Γsc∝1/Δ²; Raman coupling also changes with detuning, so scattering is not the only metric. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

stages.title: 案例介面與可識別量
stages.description: 依『IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理』畫出最小系統邊界，將下列量分成控制、狀態與量測三欄：教學參考Δ0=100 GHz、Γ0=40 s⁻¹，Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²；固定觀察窗200 μs。 對照案例來源，只保留其實際支持的架構敘述；把所有合成數值標記『教學』。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw the smallest system boundary for 'IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy'. Classify these quantities as controls, states or measurements: Teaching reference Δ0=100 GHz, Γ0=40 s⁻¹ and Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²; observation window is fixed at200 μs. Keep only architectural claims supported by the case source and label every synthetic value 'teaching'.
